newsitem.title: USA: Fidelity launches TechnoQuant Growth Fund.
newsitem.headline: Fidelity launches TechnoQuant Growth Fund.

text.p: Fidelity Investments said Thursday it has launched a new mutual fund, TechnoQuant Growth Fund, which uses technical analysis as the primary indicator for stock selections.
"TechnoQuant is the first Fidelity fund to use technical analysis as the driving force behind individual stock selection," portfolio manager Tim Krochuk said.
Krochuk uses a computer to analyse hundreds of technical indicators to predict future earnings, Fidelity said.

The fund is designed with a very aggressive focus on capital appreciation, and will likely have a high turnover, and therefore it is probably most appropriate for long-term investments or tax-deferred retirement vehicles, Fidelity said.
